what_it_may_be_used_for: bounding the signal that was discarded

DO_NOT_REPORT_AS_A_TRAJECTORY.why: FiberControl never observed these values online. Every selection, every parent choice, every credit assignment in the voided run was made against a constant 0.0, so the corrected run's policy diverges from the first decision onward. Rescoring a trajectory the controller could not have followed produces a counterfactual, not a corrected result.

base_rate_context.note: exact 0.0 is the modal outcome for a random drug-like molecule on this oracle, which is why an all-zero ledger was not self-evidently pathological and why the positive control, not the ledger distribution, is the decisive test

caveat_on_the_reference_implementation: The reference forest was frozen from gsk3b.pkl (sha 18d1cc9b..., 27,791,452 bytes); the pinned production asset is gsk3b_current.pkl (sha d3a20701..., 27,791,877 bytes). They agree exactly on the 29-molecule positive-control panel measured in the pinned image, but were not compared molecule by molecule across these 250. Treat the per-molecule values as close, not exact.
interpretation: The endpoints carried real but weak gsk3b signal: 196 of 250 nonzero, and a maximum of 0.18 against a frozen-panel known-actives mean of 0.867. So the defect hid a gradient the controller could have climbed, and hid it completely -- not a near-miss that a better metric would have caught.
method: An INDEPENDENT numpy reimplementation of the same 2048-bit TDC random forest (compose_v4.benchmark.oracles.forest), parity-validated against the original sklearn 1.2.2 estimators at max_abs_delta 0.0 on the frozen 400-molecule panel, applied offline to the 250 canonical endpoints the voided ledger recorded.
purpose: Quantify how much gsk3b signal the voided run's endpoints actually carried, so the cost of the defect is a number rather than an impression.
